research_scope: ordinary public engineering controls for simulated branch-update safety and full end-to-end rollback
frozen_input: MVP simulator version and seed untouched, missions 0..3, cycles0..15
core_architecture: original frozen MSF-selected stage1 50 + stage2 10 (union 59) -> two-stage classification re-fit -> HMM frozen parameters -> RF anomaly probabilities -> refitted or stale ordinary multinomial stacking
separate_real_binary_budget_note: MSF maximum budget 64 from OPS-SAT 2578D is fixed experimental choice, actual 37 selected, NOT applied retroactively to separate 400D synthetic state task
selectors: reuse previously frozen selected 50,10 indices originally computed ONLY from missions0,1
model_refit: hierarchical classifiers train on missions0/1, Platt calibrate only cycle8; HMM state transitions from missions0/1; anomaly old RF already fit missions0/1
update: new RF clone trained missions0/1 and cycle9 only; freeze hierarchical and HMM once re-fit, all candidate scenarios use same state model

arms.A: Old RF + reference fusion trained cycle10
arms.B: Supervised updated RF + stale reference fusion
arms.C: Supervised updated RF + ordinary fusion recalibration using SAME cycle10 labels
arms.D: Accept C only if independent cycle11 quality constraints hold, else exact rollback to A (no release)

scenarios.honest_simulated_update: Correct simulator binary anomaly labels from cycle9, not actual human review
scenarios.incorrect_label_batch: Exactly flipped binary labels for cycle9; structural metadata valid, semantic truth not verified, stress structural gate and independent downstream regression
scenarios.semantic_probability_channel_fault: Take normal C output and swap 3-class healthy/fault columns without retraining; intentional bad-wire fault verifying reject and exact A rollback, not a scientific model improvement

scientific_limits: This is the same synthetic simulator and previously inspected mission3; exploratory not fresh confirmatory validation

State feature selection uses mission0/1 only; two-stage state Platt calibration and anomaly thresholds use only cycle8; update batch cycle9; fusion fit cycle10; independent gate cycle11; mission3 audit untouched within this experiment
A deliberately corrupted class-label batch or swapped probability channels are injected faults, NOT human-reviewed correct labels or naturally observed satellite operation
Nothing ever deploys to the public delivery branch
No novel patent-specific algorithm details committed to publicly accessible repository
No physical 3-class health state annotations in real OPS-SAT, no transfer-learning requirements
acceptance_predeclared: Gate compare C to A only on cycle11, never select from mission3; D retains A prediction bit-for-bit if rejected; external approval always false
